questions.question: What force pulls objects toward Earth?
What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.funFact: Au comes from the Latin word aurum.

questions.question: Which gas do plants absorb during photosynthesis?
questions.funFact: Plants use carbon dioxide to make sugars.

questions.question: Which particle carries a negative electric charge?
questions.funFact: Electrons have a negative electric charge.

questions.question: What is the smallest unit of a chemical element?
questions.funFact: An atom retains an element's chemical identity.

questions.question: At sea level, water normally boils at which temperature?
questions.funFact: Water boils at 100°C at standard atmospheric pressure.

questions.question: Which state of matter has a fixed volume but no fixed shape?
questions.funFact: A liquid takes the shape of its container.

questions.question: What type of energy does a moving object have?
questions.funFact: Kinetic energy is the energy of motion.

questions.question: Which mammal lays eggs?
questions.funFact: The platypus is an egg-laying mammal.

questions.question: What do caterpillars develop into?
questions.funFact: Caterpillars are the larvae of butterflies and moths.

questions.question: Which part of a plant usually absorbs water?
questions.funFact: Roots absorb water from the soil.
